design.energetics: B-B attraction eps_BB varied; eps_AA and eps_AB fixed small (B loves B, A-B neutral); shared WCA core
design.k_on: auto: k_off * f_B/f_A (steady B fraction equals the initial one without feedback)

restart_semantics: completed run directories are checksum-verified and skipped; interrupted runs restart from the beginning when --recover-interrupted is supplied
